name: Sapling Toss

values.label: Area reveal radius while Sapling is in flight, pending for confirmation

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Maokai flings a Sapling to the target location, granting sight of the area while it is in-flight.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Maokai flings a Sapling to the target location, granting sight of the area while it is in-flight.

tips.tip: Can see across terrain from the center, but not into brush

parts.text: Once landed, the Sapling grants sight of its surroundings and remains stationary for 30 seconds or until it reacts to the first nearby visible enemy, chasing them for up to 2.5 seconds. The Sapling explodes upon colliding with an enemy or when it expires, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies, capped at 300 against non-champions, and slowing them by 45% for 2 seconds.

mechanics.evidence: Once landed, the Sapling grants sight of its surroundings and remains stationary for 30 seconds or until it reacts to the first nearby visible enemy, chasing them for up to 2.5 seconds.
The Sapling explodes upon colliding with an enemy or when it expires, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies, capped at 300 against non-champions, and slowing them by 45% for 2 seconds.

parts.text:
A Sapling placed in a brush becomes empowered: lasting 30 (+ 1.5% bonus health) seconds and causing its explosion to deal 66.7% damage to non-minion targets struck and attach two Saplings to them for 1.5 seconds, as well as slow enemies hit by 45% (+ 1% per 100 bonus health) (+ 1% per 100 AP) for 2 seconds and reveal them for 3 seconds. The attached Saplings explode on the afflicted target every 0.75 seconds over the duration, dealing them the same damage each time.

Targets can only be attached to two Saplings at a time; subsequent empowered Sapling explosions on a target will refresh the duration and only attach a Sapling if one has exploded on them already. Against minions, the explosion deals 100% damage. The total damage is capped at 600 against non-champions.

A Sapling placed in a brush becomes empowered: lasting 30 (+ 1.5% bonus health) seconds and causing its explosion to deal 66.7% damage to non-minion targets struck and attach two Saplings to them for 1.5 seconds, as well as slow enemies hit by 45% (+ 1% per 100 bonus health) (+ 1% per 100 AP) for 2 seconds and reveal them for 3 seconds.

parts.text: See Pets for more details about Saplings.

notes: Applies area damage from a normal Sapling and deals persistent damage to enemies hit by an empowered Sapling.
The Saplings will continue to chase their target even if they lose sight of them.

Saplings cannot be stacked on top of each other; if Sapling Toss is cast to the same point as a Sapling currently on the ground, the new Sapling will move a short distance away from the existing one upon landing.

Sapling Toss's cast does not initially fling the actual Sapling unit but instead a Sapling-like projectile that can be destroyed by projectile-interception effects.
  - The projectile will stop its flight upon colliding with Unbreakable, causing the Sapling to land in front of the barrier.

When Saplings acquire the Baron Nashor as their chase target, they will move to a specific point next to him before exploding. This behavior only occurs if the Sapling is not already within collision range.

name: Sap Magic

parts.label: Innate
parts.text: Innate: Periodically, Maokai empowers his next basic attack to have an uncancellable windup and heal him for 4 – 12.8 (based on level)% maximum health after a 0.25-second delay.

mechanics.evidence: Innate: Periodically, Maokai empowers his next basic attack to have an uncancellable windup and heal him for 4 – 12.8 (based on level)% maximum health after a 0.25-second delay.

values.context: Innate: Periodically, Maokai empowers his next basic attack to have an uncancellable windup and heal him for 4 – 12.8 (based on level)% maximum health after a 0.25-second delay.

parts.text: Each time Maokai casts an ability, hits at least one enemy champion or epic monster with Sapling Toss, or is struck by an enemy's ability, Sap Magic's cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds, modified to 1.5 if he is hit by a large monster's basic attack or ability.
Sap Magic resets Maokai's basic attack timer, and will not trigger if he is above 95% maximum health.

mechanics.evidence: Sap Magic resets Maokai's basic attack timer, and will not trigger if he is above 95% maximum health.

notes: Sap Magic does not occur if Maokai begins his attack windup before its cooldown has elapsed.
Sap Magic does not occur if the attack is dodged and/or missed if Maokai is blinded. It will occur if it is blocked.

The striking ability has to trigger spell effects such as spell damage or area damage for the cooldown to be reduced.
  - Does it trigger only from ability spell effects or any spell effects (such as Hextech Rocketbelt Super Sonic or Redemption Intervention)?
If Maokai possesses a spell shield and it consumes an enemy ability, he will still receive the cooldown reduction.
The empowered attack will not trigger against structures nor wards.
